title: Practice 3: в- and вы-: in, and out

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: The bears came out of hibernation.
exercises.why: **вышли** — past tense (plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**влез** — past tense (masculine) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

**вышла** — past tense (feminine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom unlocked the door and went in.
exercises.why: **вошёл** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

**вышли** — past tense (plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**вводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вводить: imperfective (perfective partner: ввести).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**ввели** — past tense (plural) of ввести: perfective (imperfective partner: вводить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Let's put it to a vote.
exercises.why: **вынесем** — future tense (1st person plural) of вынести: perfective (imperfective partner: выносить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**влезли** — past tense (plural) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

**вылетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вылетать: imperfective (perfective partner: вылететь).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**влетит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of влететь: perfective (imperfective partner: влетать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: We made it to the top three.
exercises.why: **вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Let's go out on the terrace.
exercises.why: **выйдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**вошёл** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: He couldn't bear to be apart from her.
exercises.why: **выносил** — past tense (masculine) of выносить: imperfective (perfective partner: вынести).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: We made it to the top five.
exercises.why: **вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**выйти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

**вывозят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вывозить: imperfective (perfective partner: вывезти).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I went out in spite of the rain.
exercises.why: **вышла** — past tense (feminine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

**вышли** — past tense (plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
